sample_unit: expert anesthesiologist raters evaluating responses to 10 FAQs

links.outcome: LLM response quality in Turkish versus English for anesthesia patient questions
links.effect: English responses of ChatGPT 4.0 and DeepSeek V3 were rated superior to Turkish responses in overall, content, and communication quality (P<0.001 for most comparisons; P=0.001 for DeepSeek communication).
links.quote: English responses of ChatGPT 4.0 were superior to the Turkish responses in the terms of overall, content, and communication quality (P<0.001 each) and English responses of DeepSeek V3 were superior to the Turkish responses in the terms of overall (P<0.001), content (P<0.001) and communication (P=0.001) quality.

screen.reason: Compares LLM response quality across models (ChatGPT-4.0 vs DeepSeek V3) and languages (English vs Turkish) for anesthesiology FAQs using expert evaluation, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
